summary: GrowthX has a current 16-week virtual Revenue Accelerator cohort launching Sept. 14, 2026, with cohort selection closing Sept. 7, 2026.

proposed_event.name: GrowthX Revenue Accelerator
proposed_event.description: 16-week virtual B2B revenue program with 1:1 coaching, pods, masterclasses, and AI-powered sales enablement.

dates.date_range_text: Rolling review; cohort selection closes Sept. 7, 2026. The next 16-week virtual cohort launches Sept. 14, 2026.

sources.title: The Revenue Accelerator - GrowthX
sources.supports: Official page states the program includes dedicated 1:1 coaching, small-group coaching, cohort masterclasses, AI-powered sales enablement, is equity-free, costs $10,000 per company, runs 16 weeks virtually, and has a next cohort in Sept. 2026. It also lists Sept. 7, 2026 as cohort selection close and Sept. 14, 2026 as program launch.

sources.title: Program Guide - GrowthX
sources.supports: Official program guide describes dedicated coaching, small-group pods, cohort-wide masterclasses, AI-powered sales enablement, and a 16-week program roadmap.

notes: GrowthX explicitly says it is structurally and operationally distinct from traditional startup accelerators, so the event is categorized as a program rather than accelerator.
No exact program end date or timezone is published; those fields are null.
GrowthX says it does not run performative demo days, so demo_day is null.
